slides.title: Why now
slides.subtitle: The market is ready for a simpler analytics layer

slides.title: Teams are drowning in dashboards they no longer trust
bullets: Analytics teams spend more than half their week maintaining reports instead of answering questions.
Business users keep exporting data into spreadsheets because the dashboards do not answer their real questions.
Every new metric takes weeks to ship because the data model is coupled to a single visualization tool.
The result is slow decisions, duplicated numbers, and low confidence in the numbers that do get shared.
slides.asideText: A semantic data layer decouples metrics from charts, so any tool can ask questions against one trusted source of truth.

slides.title: Early access shows measurable impact in weeks, not quarters
slides.takeaway: Faster answers, fewer conflicting numbers, and a data model the whole company can trust.
